findings.label: Unverified other importers of the read functions
findings.detail: fetchTasks/pollTasks changed from Promise<Task[]> to Promise<TaskReadResult>; only useTaskStream is known to call them. Run `git grep -n -E "fetchTasks|pollTasks" src` before merge or rely on a tsc typecheck (vite build alone does not type-check).
